messages:
liz: heads up: opened a small migration PR to change the dashboard widget schema for cost breakdowns. noticed two followups: the Ruby SDK snippet is missing and the example query uses `token_cost` vs `token_cost_usd`. can we split tasks?
tom: i can add the Ruby snippet. do you want idiomatic ruby or a tiny one-liner?
rebecca: i'm happy to standardize the field name. prefer `token_cost_usd` everywhere. i'll run a grep and a docs-lint patch.
aj: i'll add a docs-lint rule to catch `token_cost` variants and a small test. also will add a short migration note in the dashboard migration guide.
docs-bot: PR 501 opened by liz  reviewers: @rebecca @tom. CI: docs-link-check pending, docs-lint queued.
sam_k: quick note about the widget schema: we renamed `breakdown.items` to `breakdown.buckets` in runtime PR 812; make sure examples match buckets or UX will break.
liz: good catch. include a one-line compatibility note: show old vs new JSON keys and a code block with a migration snippet (jq one-liner).
tom: draft Ruby snippet: ```ruby
require "redwood"
hook = Redwood::TraceHook.new(service: "console")
hook.attach_context({ trace_id: trace_id })
hook.set_tag("token_cost_usd", 0.0025)
hook.set_tag("latency_ms", 95)
```
rebecca: looks good. i'll run repo replace for `token_cost` -> `token_cost_usd` and update examples to use `breakdown.buckets`. will add migration note to CHANGELOG and the migration guide.
aj: pushing a tiny docs-lint PR to block the old key. will also add an autofix script for maintainers.
docs-bot: docs-link-check found one broken anchor in docs/console/widgets.md (#widget-breakdown). scheduling auto-fix.
sam_k: anchor fixed. ran staging preview and widget example renders. one remaining thing: the playground embed for the interactive widget uses an old URL param `showOld=true`. i'd recommend removing that param and adding a short note about toggling legacy mode.
liz: plan: rebecca runs the key rename + migration note, tom adds Ruby snippet, aj lands the lint, sam_k verifies staging preview. target: merge tomorrow morning, then send a short announcement in #docs when live. thanks all. /end of thread
